evidence: all 33 pilot renders passed engineering constraints
f0_std_fraction clearly changes HNR, CPP, and several spectral diagnostics
amplitude_std_db and f0_amplitude_correlation effects are mostly comparable to within-setting seed spread
measurement adapter 1.0.0 omitted estimates.f0_hz when flattening the feature bundle, so the stored F0 column is invalid; direct qualification found 77/77 B9 frames available
the B10-scale f0 variation improves median pitch_voicing target similarity but worsens the worst resonance and signal-integrity similarities
existing listening evidence prefers B9 over B10, so maximizing the current pitch proxy can reverse a known perceptual direction
source_voice_quality target similarity is nearly saturated across settings and is not sufficiently discriminative for selection

parameter_decisions.f0_std_fraction: retain as a measurable diversity axis, but do not optimize monotonically toward the current pitch score
parameter_decisions.amplitude_std_db: retain for ablation; do not allocate a dense search until its effect exceeds seed variability
parameter_decisions.f0_amplitude_correlation: retain as a diversity axis only
parameter_decisions.spectral_tilt_lowpass_hz: remain fixed because range provenance is missing
parameter_decisions.variation_lowpass_hz: remain fixed because range provenance is missing

required_before_a3: rerun A1 through A2b with measurement adapter 1.0.1 and preserve v1 as superseded evidence
add time-structure targets whose reference distributions and estimator meanings are compatible
define candidate objectives that preserve known B9-over-B10 perceptual direction without treating it as a universal score
freeze the revised objective and its regression before generating 64 settings
parallel_next_work: prepare an onset-specific G40 measurement contract and sensitivity campaign
keep longitudinal listening and autonomous engineering work independent

resource_cap_basis.note: caps include substantial margin for reference comparisons and reporting; reaching a cap stops rather than expands the campaign

superseded_measurement_field.cause: adapter 1.0.0 did not copy FeatureBundle.estimates.f0_hz.value into values
superseded_measurement_field.scope: stored f0_hz values and availability only; raw audio and other scalar features remain available
